seo.title: Factors of 20 Math Clicker - Division & Divisibility Practice
seo.metaDescription: Spot all 6 factors of 20 on a 10x10 math grid. Fast-paced factor pair identification for elementary and middle school students.
seo.intro: Twenty is a composite number with 6 factors: 1, 2, 4, 5, 10, and 20. Its factor pairs are 1 x 20, 2 x 10, and 4 x 5. Locating these factors on a 100-number board strengthens connections between fives, tens, and evens, laying essential groundwork for percentage benchmarks (like 5%, 10%, 20%, 25%, and 50%).
seo.howToPlay: Click all 6 factors of 20 on the 100-tile grid. Correct tiles turn green with a checkmark. Incorrect clicks flash red and deduct 2 seconds from your round clock. Locate all 6 factors before time runs out.
seo.teacherNotes: Connect the factors of 20 to money and coins: 1 cent (pennies), 2 cents, 5 cents (nickels), 10 cents (dimes), and 20 cents.
